rules: Global navigation links only to LIVE + INDEX routes.
Header is bounded to six primary choices.
Footer is bounded to five columns and six links per column.
Use hubs for breadth; do not enumerate all 90 routes globally.
Virtual Apple/Guide nodes may be labels but never href targets.
Brand/Series/Guide candidates stay out of Header/Footer/Homepage until released.
Contextual sibling/child discovery remains delegated to runtime architecture rather than global navigation.
